# IPTV Poland

> IPTV Poland is a subscription IPTV service built specifically around Polish television — Ekstraklasa live football matches, Polish news, entertainment, and regional channels — carried alongside the same full English-language and international catalog every plan includes, not in place of it. A meaningful share of the real audience is Polish households and fans living abroad (UK, US, Germany, Ireland, Netherlands, and elsewhere) who want Polish TV and Ekstraklasa without a Polish cable subscription; nothing about ordering, activation, or watching requires a Polish address, and no VPN is needed since channels stream directly to the login. Plans include 40,000+ live channels and 180,000+ VOD titles, identical across every plan length — a longer term lowers the price, it never unlocks extra content. Subscriptions run 1, 3, 6, or 12 months ($14.99 / $34.99 / $54.99 / $79.99 USD), with a $1.00 24-hour trial available before committing, running the identical live catalog a paying subscriber gets. Compatible with Smart TVs, Android TV, Fire TV, Android and iOS devices, Apple TV, Windows, and macOS.
